Thanks for the demo earlier, Jordan — Elena here. Team is excited. Two quick clarifying items we discussed that will drive whether we start with Hosted or push for Dedicated:

1) Data residency and audit logs — we have to provide per-session audit logs to our compliance team for the pilot. Is that available in Hosted or does that require Dedicated/Private?
2) Rate caps — our initial estimate is 30 concurrent users, peak 120 requests/minute, ~10k tokens/minute. Will Hosted keep us within predictable latency at that load?

If Hosted can meet the audit logs requirement and we can get a runbook for rate limits and retry behavior, we'd prefer the faster path. Can you share a succinct checklist we can circulate?

—Elena

Elena — thanks, quick answers inline:

- Audit logs: Hosted provides session-level request logs (request id, timestamp, model, prompt hash) with 90-day retention in the console and downloadable CSVs. If your compliance requires longer retention or HSM-backed immutable logs, Dedicated or Private is the path. We can export logs to your S3 for the pilot.

- Rate caps & latency: Hosted enforces per-account rate limits by default. For your numbers (120 r/min, bursts up to ~200/min), Hosted should be fine; typical 95th percentile latency at that throughput on our Hosted fleet for medium-size models is ~160–220ms/token. Ben, can you confirm the cost estimate for 10k tokens/min sustained under Hosted vs a small Dedicated reservation?

Next steps I suggest:
1) We share the one-page checklist and a quick S3 export playbook (attached).
2) BrightRetail confirms whether 90-day logs are sufficient for pilot. If yes, we proceed with Hosted pilot. If no, we'll run a short feasibility call for Dedicated.

If it helps, I can schedule a 30-minute ops call Monday.

Thanks,
Jordan

Hi Elena — ran the numbers for Hosted vs a 1-card Dedicated pool for a 30-day pilot. High level:

- Hosted: Estimated token cost ~ $2,800 for 30 days at your projected 10k tokens/min sustained for peak windows (assumes aggressive prefix caching and batching suggestions applied). No upfront commitment; we can raise rate limits temporarily for the pilot with a short-term quota tweak.

- Dedicated (small): Monthly committed cost estimate $7,500 + nominal infra setup. Predictable throughput and lower per-token marginal cost beyond the commit. Dedicated would also allow longer retention for logs with in-cluster storage and more control of network egress settings.

Tradeoffs: Hosted is faster to start and cheaper short-term; Dedicated gives more deterministic latency at scale and stronger isolation (helpful if you hit compliance roadblocks).

I recommend Hosted for the 30-day pilot unless compliance requires immutable/HSM-backed logs. If you want, we can provide a short run of a load test on Hosted to validate latency at your 120 r/min bursts.

-Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
